newsitem.title: CHINA: HK'S ASIA COMMERCIAL BANK SEEN PLANNING HK$ FRCD.
newsitem.headline: HK'S ASIA COMMERCIAL BANK SEEN PLANNING HK$ FRCD.

text.p: Asia Commercial Bank is seen planning a Hong Kong dollar floating rate certificate of deposit issue, bankers said.
They said the facility is expected to have an issue size of between HK$400 million and HK$500 million. Its maturity is likely to be more than three years, bankers noted.
Pricing is not finalised, but the issue is likely to be launched into general syndication in September or October, bankers noted.

Last October, the issuer paid an all-in return of 83 basis points to top-tier managers for its HK$550 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue. The issue had a final maturity of five years with a put and a call option in years three and four.
